# Common Workflows

This page describes common workflows for using tfctl to manage HCP Terraform resources. These workflows demonstrate typical use cases and best practices.

## Requirements

Before following these workflows, ensure you have:

- tfctl installed and authenticated
- Access to an HCP Terraform organization
- Appropriate permissions for the operations you want to perform

## Configure tfctl

The tfctl CLI uses a layered configuration system. You can configure settings in profiles, environment variables, or local Terraform configuration, in order of precedence.

### Set default organization

Run the [`tfctl profile set`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/set) command to set the default organization. Replace `<name>` with your HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise organization name:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile set default_organization <name>
```

### Manage profiles

Use the `tfctl profile profiles` command group to create and manage profiles. You can use a different profile for each HCP Terraform organization and each instance of HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise.

To create a profile, run the `tfctl profile profiles create` command and specify a name. Replace `<name>` with a name for your new profile:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create <name>
```

The CLI activates the new profile automatically.

### Example: Multiple profiles across instances

The following example demonstrates checking workspace status across two HCP Terraform instances and starting a run:

```shell-session
# Configure profiles for EU and US organizations
$ tfctl profile profiles create us --hostname=app.terraform.io
$ tfctl profile set default_organization my-us-org-name
$ tfctl auth login

$ tfctl profile profiles create eu --hostname=app.eu.terraform.io
$ tfctl profile set default_organization my-eu-org-name
$ tfctl auth login

# Get workspace configuration from EU org
$ tfctl api /organizations/{organization}/workspaces/example-app-workspace

# Get status of last workspace run
$ tfctl run status example-app-workspace

# Switch to US profile
$ tfctl profile profiles activate us

# Start a run on the US workspace
$ tfctl run start example-app-workspace --message="Run started with tfctl."

# Get detailed run status in JSON format
$ tfctl run status example-app-workspace --json
```

## Manage runs

Use tfctl to start and monitor Terraform runs in your workspaces.

### Start a new run

1. Start a new run using the [`tfctl run start`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/start) command:

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl run start
   ```

   The command creates a new run and displays the run ID.

1. Monitor the run status using the [`tfctl run status`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/status) command:

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl run status <run-id>
   ```

## Configure variables

Use tfctl to import and manage workspace variables.

### Import variables from a file

1. Create a variables file in JSON or HCL format with your variable definitions.

1. Import the variables using the [`tfctl variable import`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/variable/import) command:

   ```shell-session
   $ tfctl variable import --file variables.json
   ```

   The command imports the variables into your workspace.
